summary: Quote and LTP on the NIFTY index: the index channel gives the value, high, low and previous close, the day bucket the open; a Depth subscribe on the index is refused with the web's words.

deviations.reason: Before the day bucket the web sends open 0 (ohlcv.get('open', 0)); a field the stream has not sent is left out (web openalgo#2376), as the desktop does.

Once the day bucket came the web sends the bucket's close (today's price) as close, ahead of prev_close (ohlcv.get('close', prev_close)); close is the previous day's close, which the desktop keeps sending (the audit's 'Nubra bucket close' note).
